services.desc: ALL LOCATIONS ARE NOW WEEKENDS ONLY! :( While we are no longer accepting jetski walk ups on weekdays, skii reservations can still be made online and we will be there to get you out! Dismiss Kayak, Paddleboard, and Canoe Rental Hours below may change based on weather, please check our site or call ahead if questionable. Last Rental is at 5:45 June-August. Last Rental is at 4:45 May & September. **Off Season Rentals are based on weather and are self serve. After hours rentals are available, call for details. We do not rent if wind speeds are over 15mph. Rentals must be returned 15 minutes prior to closing. We do offer sunset guided tours, please reserve your space for these tours by clicking
